toegepas.blok: Hoe siektes oorgaan en hoe hulle wys
toegepas.na: Die siek mens ervaar hulle self.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Die mens' has no antecedent in this block; 'die siek mens' matches the next sentence and the earlier 'n siek mens'.
toegepas.fout: 'Die mens' has no antecedent in its own sentence pair; the last mention is three sentences back.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Die siek mens' fixes the reference and matches the block's own next sentence; protected 'wat hy self ervaar' is not touched.

toegepas.voor: hoofpyn en is kou of sluk pynlik
toegepas.na: hoofpyn, en is dit pynlik om te kou of te sluk
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'is kou of sluk pynlik' is wooden; a clause with its own subject reads naturally and takes the AWS comma before 'en'.
toegepas.fout: 'is kou of sluk pynlik' is wooden, with bare verbs as subject.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'is dit pynlik om te kou of te sluk' is the natural construction, keeps 'Dikwels' over both clauses, and the AWS comma is correct between two clauses.

toegepas.voor: Die mens kan ook koors hê
toegepas.na: Iemand met TB kan ook koors hê
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Die mens' has no clear antecedent; the block speaks of 'iemand met TB'.
toegepas.fout: 'Die mens' has no clear antecedent after the sentence about the warning cough.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Iemand met TB' picks up the block's own phrase and says the same thing; no protected wording is touched.

toegepas.voor: Jy kan nies en 'n loopneus of toe neus, keelseer en hoes kry.
toegepas.na: Jy kan nies en ook 'n loopneus of toe neus, keelseer en 'n hoes kry.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The verb 'nies' reads as the first item of the noun list; 'ook' separates the two verb phrases and ''n hoes' makes 'hoes' clearly a noun.
toegepas.fout: The verb 'nies' runs into the noun list, so a reader stumbles on 'nies en 'n loopneus'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'ook' separates the verb from the noun list and ''n hoes' marks hoes as a noun; nothing is added or lost.

toegepas.rede_vinder: In a relative clause the verb goes last.
toegepas.fout: Verb placed before its phrase in a relative clause, copying English 'dry up into crusts'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'wat tot korsies opdroog' is the standard Afrikaans order for a relative clause, with no change in meaning.

toegepas.rede_vinder: A disease does not 'become healthy'; the protected wording is 'TB kan gesond gemaak word'.
toegepas.fout: 'TB kan gesond word' says the disease becomes healthy and departs from the protected wording.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The proposal restores the protected wording 'TB kan gesond gemaak word' exactly, keeping 'kan' and adding no condition.

toegepas.na: gee die beste kans om gesond te word.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'die beste kans' is left hanging (a chance of what?); the protected wording completes it with 'om gesond te word'.
toegepas.fout: 'die beste kans' is left hanging without saying a chance of what.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Completing it with the protected wording 'die beste kans om gesond te word' fixes the dangling phrase without making it a guarantee.

toegepas.voor: Vra 'n verpleegster of dokter of by jou skool.
toegepas.na: Vra 'n verpleegster, 'n dokter of iemand by jou skool.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The two 'of's join unlike parts (people and a place phrase); a parallel list of three people reads cleanly.
toegepas.fout: The two 'of's join unlike parts (people and a place phrase), which reads clumsily.
toegepas.rede_keurder: A parallel list of three people says the same thing more cleanly; 'iemand by jou skool' is what 'vra by jou skool' already meant.

toegepas.voor: wat mense sê of aanlyn staan
toegepas.na: wat mense sê of wat aanlyn staan
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'wat' is object in the first clause and subject in the second, so it must be repeated.
toegepas.fout: 'wat' is object in the first clause and subject in the second without being repeated.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Repeating 'wat' fixes the grammar and removes the stumble, with no change in meaning.

laat_vaar.blok: Hoe siektes oorgaan en hoe hulle wys
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Movement into the air takes the postposition: 'die lug in', not 'in die lug'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'spat in die lug' is an established, natural Afrikaans phrase; the postposition form is only a different way of saying the same thing.

laat_vaar.voor: Droog jou voete goed af tussen die tone
laat_vaar.na: Droog jou voete goed tussen die tone af
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The separable particle 'af' belongs at the end of the clause, after the place phrase.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Placing the place phrase after the particle in an imperative is natural Afrikaans, and the proposal reads no better, arguably worse.

laat_vaar.na: dadelik as dit moeilik word om asem te haal
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'asemhaal' as a bare subject is stiff; 'as dit moeilik word om asem te haal' is the natural phrase.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'as asemhaal moeilik word' is acceptable Afrikaans, and this is a safety instruction about when to go to the clinic, so its wording stays with the writer.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: Strictly a person is made healthy, not a disease; 'TB kan genees word' would be the idiomatic form, but it is listed under NIE, so the protected form is proposed as is.
